summary: Pack assistant list pages into the whole-response byte budget without dropping items

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery changes.

schema.detail: No stored schema, index, or data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest rule changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Existing assistant list response and cursor shapes are preserved. Pages may contain fewer than the requested limit to fit the existing envelope byte budget; their cursor continues immediately after the last delivered item. A single item that cannot fit produces response-budget-exceeded naming its ID. Malformed cached-page cursors with out-of-contract limits or offsets outside their snapshot return page-cursor-expired rather than entering page packing.

downtime.detail: No added startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action or client configuration change required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions.
